name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor and the collaboration layer. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo, exactly as before.

platforms.android-arm64: shipped (solo; collaboration needs a LAN transport, not yet built)
